Tell us about your store

A Shopify and Wix agency for ecommerce brands.

We only work on things that sell online.

ORVANE designs, builds and improves ecommerce stores and business websites. Our focus is Shopify and Wix, plus the SEO, email and conversion work that sits around them.

A good store is clear. Visitors know what you sell, trust you quickly and find checkout without effort. Most of our work is removing the things that get in the way.

We work directly with you, in plain language, with no layers of account managers. You always know what is happening and what comes next.

The Story Behind ORVANE

ORVANE began in 2020 with a vision from its founder, Franklin, who set out to help businesses build a stronger presence in the digital world.

What started with a passion for website design and ecommerce gradually grew into something bigger. As the vision developed, Franklin reached out to talented specialists across different parts of the world, bringing together people with different skills, experiences and expertise to become part of the ORVANE team.

Through this vision, he has been able to build a team that brings together website design, development, ecommerce, SEO and digital marketing under one roof.

Today, ORVANE helps businesses create better digital experiences, strengthen their online presence and build platforms designed for growth.

Founded by Franklin in 2020. Built through collaboration. Driven by a shared vision.

Legal

Privacy Policy

Last updated: November 13, 2026

This policy explains what information ORVANE collects through this website, why we collect it and what we do with it. ORVANE is a digital agency founded by Franklin in 2020. If you have any questions, email us at ralafranklin61@gmail.com.

Information we collect

Project enquiries. When you use the contact form we receive the details you type in: your name, email address, business or brand name, website, the service you need, budget, timeline and project description.

AI assistant chats. If you use the ORVANE AI Assistant, the messages you type are sent to our server so it can reply. If you choose to start an enquiry from the chat, the project details you mentioned are copied into the contact form on your screen. They are only sent to us if you press the send button on that form.

Messages on other platforms. If you contact us by email, WhatsApp, Fiverr, Instagram, Facebook or TikTok, those platforms handle your information under their own policies, and we receive what you send us.

Technical information. Like any website, the service that hosts this site and the service that provides our fonts can receive your IP address and basic browser details when your browser loads the page. We do not run advertising trackers or analytics tools on this site, and we do not set cookies ourselves.

How we use it

  • To reply to your enquiry and discuss your project.
  • To prepare quotes and plan and deliver work for you.
  • To keep the website and the AI assistant working and secure.

We do not sell your personal information and we do not use it for advertising.

The AI assistant

The assistant is an automated AI system, so it can make mistakes. It does not replace advice from a person, and its answers about services are not a quote or an offer. Please do not share sensitive information in the chat, such as passwords, payment details or ID numbers. Our server does not store the content of chat messages. The chat history exists only in your browser tab and disappears when you close or refresh the page.

Who we share information with

We use these providers to run the site. They process information on our behalf, under their own terms and privacy policies:

  • GitHub hosts the website.
  • Cloudflare runs the server and the AI model behind the chat assistant.
  • FormSubmit delivers contact form submissions to our email inbox, and Google (Gmail) receives them.
  • Google Fonts supplies the typefaces used on the site.

We may also share information if the law requires it. Your information may be processed in countries other than your own, because our team and these providers work internationally.

How long we keep it

We keep enquiries and project messages for as long as we need them to respond to you, deliver work and keep reasonable business records. After that we delete them.

Your choices

You can ask us to tell you what information we hold about you, to correct it or to delete it. Email us at the address below and we will respond. If you do not want us to contact you, tell us and we will stop.

Children

This website is for businesses and is not aimed at children. We do not knowingly collect information from children.

Links to other sites

This site links to other services such as Fiverr, WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook and TikTok. We are not responsible for how they handle your information.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top shows when it last changed.
